projects.title: Kinescope - Full-Stack Video Platform with AI Agents
projects.description: A full-stack YouTube-style video platform built with React and Node/Express/MongoDB, with Cloudinary video upload, comments, subscriptions, and playlists, deployed on Render with GitHub CI/CD. Includes two LangGraph AI agents on Gemini: a RAG-based recommendation engine grounded in a user's real watch/like history, and a hallucination-safe video-chat assistant that answers only from retrieved video metadata.

projects.title: Adaptive RAG Chatbot (Agentic AI, Full-Stack)
projects.description: An agentic RAG chatbot using LangGraph that classifies each query with an LLM and dynamically routes it to document retrieval, general knowledge, or live web search (Tavily API). Features a self-correcting retrieval pipeline with LLM-based relevance grading and automatic query rewriting on low-relevance results, backed by a FAISS vector store and Groq-hosted LLMs. Deployed as a full-stack production app (FastAPI backend on Render, Streamlit frontend on Streamlit Cloud) with persistent, session-based chat history in MongoDB Atlas.

projects.title: LearnMind - AI-Assisted E-Learning Platform (Backend)
projects.description: A full-stack, AI-assisted e-learning platform with role-based authentication for students and other users. Integrated the Gemini API for an adaptive assessment engine generating personalized exams, student diagnostic dashboards for real-time performance insights, Socket.IO notifications to boost engagement, and an AI tutoring chatbot for interactive learning support.
